object: Bauhaus Building, Dessau — workshop glazed corner and bridge
creator: Walter Gropius
work_date: Building designed and built 1925–1926; photograph of its later surviving/restored state
branch: Historical Bauhaus architecture; workshop facade and connected building volumes
attribution: Leojng, Fassade des Bauhausgebädes, Dessau 2019.jpg, photographed 16 November 2019, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. Provider 1280px thumbnail retained without local modifications.
rights_evidence: The exact Commons file/API record credits Leojng, states the photograph date and CC BY-SA 4.0. This license applies to the photo; it is not a new license to every use of the depicted architecture.
claim_scope: A clearly visible glazed corner and workshop-to-bridge volume relationship in the actual Bauhaus school building. Architecture branch only; broader Modernism overlaps and visual resemblance cannot establish historical identity.
limits: A close workshop-facade and bridge exterior view, not the entire building plan or all Bauhaus media. Three small visitors at the far lower-left bridge opening do not cover the main glazed corner. Natural tree reflections and sunlight remain; they are not facade ornament. No BAUHAUS end-wall lettering or projecting main entrance canopy is visible in this view. Do not infer interior circulation, load-bearing details, energy performance or a new object’s historical identity.
observable_features: Two large multi-storey glazed workshop planes meet at an exposed corner and are divided by a fine repeated metal grid.
White horizontal base and roof bands frame the transparent gridded volume without applied historical decoration.
At the left a lower horizontally glazed bridge volume joins the taller workshop block; its opening and connecting relationship remain legible.
The facade and internal floor-edge bands are readable across the main image, with no tree branches or foreground objects crossing the central corner.

association_evidence.supports: The exact file record identifies a 2019 view of the Bauhaus building in Dessau, credits Leojng and specifies CC BY-SA 4.0.

The building’s own institution identifies Gropius’s 1925–1926 Bauhaus school building and discusses its steel/concrete/glass architectural context. It establishes building identity and history; the selected photograph provides the particular view.
